issues.title: Narration timing must come from LLM, not calculated from TTS
issues.description: The LLM (brain) should provide authoritative timing for each narration_segment via the 'duration' field. The player should use these durations directly. We should NOT recalculate or scale timings based on actual TTS audio duration.
issues.root_cause: Agent incorrectly added code to recalculate timed_segments by scaling LLM durations based on actual Narakeet audio duration. This contradicts the 'LLM as brain' architecture.
issues.solution: 1. Remove _generate_timed_segments() function from tts/generate_audio.py. 2. Remove duration scaling logic. 3. Player should convert LLM's narration_segments[].duration to timed_segments with start_time/end_time directly.

issues.title: Manim only renders FIRST visual beat - multi-beat rendering not implemented
issues.description: The manim_runner.py previously only rendered the first visual beat for Manim sections, ignoring subsequent beats.
issues.root_cause: Incomplete implementation - multi-beat Manim rendering was deferred with TODO comment.
issues.solution: 1. Added _render_all_beats() function in manim_runner.py that iterates through ALL visual_beats. 2. Each beat renders as topic_{id}_beat_{i}.mp4 (0-indexed). 3. Added STANDALONE BEAT RULE to prompts: each beat's manim_scene_spec must include ALL objects visible at that moment (cumulative state). 4. Player already supports beat_videos array with detectBeatVideos() that auto-discovers these files.
key_decisions: STANDALONE BEAT RULE: Each beat video is a complete snapshot, not a delta
LLM decides what persists across beats; renderer just executes each beat independently
Player switches between beat videos based on timed_segments timing
